results.evidence: parse_received wraps to_utc_iso in try/except OverflowError and re-raises ValueError('date and time is out of range'). The UTC branch now catches (ValueError, OverflowError). tests/test_parse_received_overflow.py covers 9999-12-31 23:30 raising ValueError, the edge UTC times that still convert, and inbound.validate reporting the error on the 'received' field. All gates passed: pytest 938 passed, ruff check clean, mypy no issues in 107 files, ruff format --check 317 files already formatted. I did not run a year-1 local-time case. Denver is behind UTC, so that case cannot overflow on the low end.
